batch: September 4, 2026 - Wexford Executive Committee PFAS packet reconciliation
methods: Calculated SHA-256, byte size and page count for the supplied PDF and compared its hash with every published catalog.
Reviewed embedded text on all 15 pages; no page required OCR or manual transcription.
Visually verified the cover, the PFAS disposal request and the two-page EGLE initial PFAS monitoring correspondence and schedule.
Reused the byte-identical published PFAS-archive record as a cross reference and created no filename-based duplicate.

exactCrossReferences.finding: The packet already preserves the October 13, 2020 proposal to dispose of an estimated 250-300 tons of PFAS-contaminated Bay City fire-station soil at the Wexford County Landfill and EGLE's initial Cedar Creek Township drinking-water PFAS monitoring requirement.
exactCrossReferences.boundary: The agenda item records a request and recommendation for discussion, not final approval or completed disposal; the EGLE correspondence sets a future sampling requirement and supplies no analytical result.

queueDecision: No evidence-request item is closed. This exact existing record does not provide Wexford-to-Cadillac delivery manifests, WWTP receiving logs, delivery-linked invoices or customer-ledger entries, an executed leachate-treatment agreement, renewals, a cessation record, synchronized WWTP PFAS sampling, certified well construction, hydraulic testing or a source-to-receptor PFAS package.
evidentiaryBoundary: The packet documents a proposed 2020 out-of-county PFAS-soil disposal request and an initial drinking-water sampling obligation. It does not establish that the proposed soil was accepted or disposed, provide resulting PFAS measurements, document historical leachate deliveries to Cadillac, demonstrate treatment pass-through or prove a groundwater migration pathway.
